eleven_factor_criterion.state: proved as a purely algebraic theorem, without AS or noetherian assumptions
eleven_factor_criterion.origin: The finite-corner criterion was already present in the separate current project paper cubic_heart_corner.tex. Its complete proof was audited and integrated here, not claimed as first discovered in this revision.
eleven_factor_criterion.statement: C=B/BpB is finite-dimensional precisely when the remaining eighteen coefficients are nonzero and the nine two-by-two minors of Q, det Q, and the determinant of entrywise reciprocal Q are nonzero.
eleven_factor_criterion.proof_method: Necessity by explicit k[t] representations with a surviving cycle; sufficiency by reconstruction of six classical general-position points and all-degree Serre factorization through the structure vertex.

specified_AOU_t_exactness.state: proved under the specified admissible AOU and standard right-noetherian periodic AS hypotheses
specified_AOU_t_exactness.statement: The pointed AOU functor is t-exact iff the natural corner is an abelian equivalence iff C is finite-dimensional iff the explicit eighteen-nonzero and eleven-factor conditions hold.
specified_AOU_t_exactness.new_connection: Uses the previously proved structure-object identification; proves automatic corner bimodule finiteness and coherent high-Ext tail vanishing in the standard AS setting. The reverse implication factors all high orbit morphisms through the structure object.

automatic_finiteness.statement: Finite C implies both corner bimodules are finite over pBp. Right-noetherian B implies right-noetherian pBp.

coefficient_geometry.state: proved for the geometric coefficient-torus quotient, not the full AS moduli stack
coefficient_geometry.statement: D(Delta) in the four-cross-ratio torus is the ordered six-point cubic moduli. The finite-corner open in the eight-dimensional coefficient quotient is noncanonically M_cubic times (G_m)^4; an integral section splits the torus map.

current_results.retained_results: The earlier VdB/Rains comparison, genuine elliptic derived comparison, HRS tilt, resonance sign results, AOU pointedness and relative object statement, and mixed A2 results are retained. Their full proofs were not all independently re-audited in this iteration.
